sources.title: X-Ray AI — Chest X-Ray Pneumonia Detection - GitHub
sources.snippet: X-Ray AI is a Machine Learning project that analyzes chest X-ray images and classifies them into two categories: 🫁 NORMAL 🦠 PNEUMONIA The project uses a Linear Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier trained on chest X-ray images. A modern Streamlit web application provides a simple interface where users can upload an X-ray image and receive the model's prediction.

sources.snippet: Purpose of Review This review explores the current use of artificial intelligence (AI) in pneumonia diagnosis and outcome prediction. It aims to highlight advancements in AI technologies, focusing on both imaging and electronic health record-based approaches, their impact on improving diagnostic accuracy, and predicting clinical outcomes.
